description: SifiPipeline.bowtie_to_lst on tests/data/bowtie_output_mm2.txt (real bowtie 1.3.1, -a -v 2 -y). bowtie always writes 8 columns but leaves the mismatch descriptor empty on exact hits; the leading .strip() then removes it, so those rows arrive as 7 fields and get the integer 0 appended. Both shapes and both strands are present.
